test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Red Data Book provides data on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**endangered plants and animals.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Red Data Book of the Russian Federation, also known as** Red Book or Russian Red Data Book.**
 
• It is a state document established for documenting** rare and endangered species of animals, plants and fungi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Red data book is The document establishded by IUCN for documenting the rare and endangered species** of plants, animals, fungi and also a few local species that exist within a state or country**.
 
• It divides species into nine categories:** ******Not Evaluated, Data Deficient, Least Concern, Near Threatened, Vulnerable, Endangered, Critically Endangered, Extinct in the Wild and Extinct****.
